components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per card at most. Fills Signal Blue when the user commits something.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--accent, #3b5bdb); color: var(--accent-fg, #ffffff); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.43; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3b5bdb); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action and toggle. Border turns blue on hover; nothing moves.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2dc); background: transparent; color: var(--fg, #1b1d22); padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #3b5bdb); color: var(--accent, #3b5bdb); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3b5bdb); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Full-width field on the page canvas. Focus shifts the border to Signal Blue.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Micro-commitment</label><input class="ds-input" placeholder="One tiny step toward a habit" />

components.css: .ds-hint-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-hint-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6b7280); } .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; height: 1rem; width: 1rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2dc); background: transparent; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; color: var(--muted, #6b7280); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-hint:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #3b5bdb); color: var(--accent, #3b5bdb); } .ds-hint:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3b5bdb); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-hint-pop { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 1.5rem; z-index: 20; width: 14rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2dc); background: var(--card, #ffffff); padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--muted, #6b7280); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); }

components.name: Task Row

components.css: .ds-task { display: block; width: 100%; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e2dc); background: transparent; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; text-align: left; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--fg, #1b1d22); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-task:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #3b5bdb); } .ds-task:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3b5bdb); } .ds-task:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; } .ds-task-bucket { margin-right: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6b7280); }

narrative.overview:
A cleared wooden desk with one thing on it. The interface is warm off-white paper, thin grey rules, and a single blue mark where the next action lives. Nothing else competes for attention. The system is quiet on purpose: a person arrives on a hard day, and the screen must not add weight.

This is an Operate surface. Familiar patterns win over expression. Cards stack in one narrow column, each one holding a single step. The color count is small, the type scale is short, and the spacing does the separating work that borders and boxes would otherwise do loudly.

Precision shows as restraint. Every control has the same 8px radius, the same border tone, and the same focus ring. The one blue accent marks action and current position, and it appears rarely enough to stay meaningful. Depth is a whisper: a card shadow that reads as paper lift, never as a floating panel.
keyCharacteristics: One column, 672px max, generous vertical rhythm.
Warm paper background in light mode, near-black blue-grey in dark mode.
A single blue accent reserved for action, active state, and focus.
Small uppercase labels carry section meaning; headings stay at 24px or below.
Borders define structure; shadows stay almost invisible.
Monospace only for numbers that tick and keys that get copied.
Every screen offers one clear next action and no count that shames.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue marks action, active state, or focus. Never decoration, never a category tag, never a chart series.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces separate by tone and hairline, not by saturation. No tinted panels, no colored headers.

rules.name: The Small Label Rule
rules.body: A card opens with a 12px uppercase muted label, not an 18px heading. Meaning comes from case and color, so the eye is not pulled into hierarchy.

rules.name: The Two-Size Rule
rules.body: A screen has one title size (24px) and one body size (14px). Intermediate sizes exist only for the highlight task (18px) and stat values (20px).

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes over time uses tabular-nums. Any key or token the user copies uses Geist Mono.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: If a boundary is needed, add a hairline border before a shadow. Shadows never carry meaning on their own.

rules.name: The No-Float Rule
rules.body: Controls never lift on hover. Hover changes border color or opacity, never position or elevation.

dos: Do use the card, input, btn, btnGhost, and label constants from components/ui.tsx. They are the system.
Do open every card with a 12px uppercase Quiet Grey label.
Do keep Signal Blue for action, active, and focus. One primary button per card.
Do pair every number with a plain-language hint in 12px Quiet Grey, so the user does not have to interpret the metric.
Do keep error text at 14px Ember with role="alert", and offer Retry.
Do show a skeleton that matches the real layout while data loads, with aria-busy and motion-reduce respected.
Do keep the bottom padding at 96px so the final card is reachable on a phone.
donts: Don't add a second accent color, a gradient, or a colored section background.
Don't lift, scale, or translate controls on hover.
Don't use red for missed days, streaks, counters, or urgency. Ember is for errors only.
Don't turn a label into a heading to add emphasis. Size and case carry the hierarchy.
Don't introduce a modal, drawer, or toast pattern. Feedback stays inline in the card that caused it.
Don't add a chip, badge, or tag component. Use Ghost buttons and uppercase bucket tags.
Don't set interactive text below 14px or hint text below 12px.
Don't add a manual theme toggle. Follow the operating system.
